level1.text: A skier's weight is 720 N. It is spread evenly over the bases of the skis, whose total area is 0.30 m². How large is the pressure that the skis exert on the snow?
The deepest point of Lake Päijänne is at a depth of about $95\,\text{m}$. How large is the hydrostatic pressure there? The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg/m}^3$. Give the answer in kilopascals.

A pressure gauge has been installed on the bottom of a lake at a depth of $18.0\,\text{m}$. During a low-pressure weather system the atmospheric pressure at the surface of the lake is 98.5 kPa. What is the total pressure at the gauge? The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg/m}^3$.

The weight of a sauna stove is 750 N. The stove stands on four legs whose total area against the floor is 0.0025 m². How large is the pressure that the legs exert on the floor? Give the answer in kilopascals.
The depth of the water in a sauna bucket is $0.45\,\text{m}$. How large is the hydrostatic pressure at the bottom of the bucket? The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg/m}^3$.

level2.text: A person's weight is 600 N. At the start of a step the person presses on a parquet floor for a moment with only the heel of a high-heeled shoe, whose contact area with the floor is 1.5 cm². How large is the pressure that the heel exerts on the floor? Give the answer in megapascals (MPa); the prefix mega means a million.

A house gets its water from a water tower. When the taps are closed, a pressure gauge at the tap in the cellar shows a gauge pressure of 350 kPa. How high above the tap is the water surface in the tower? The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg/m}^3$.

The graph shows the pressures of two liquids, A and B, as a function of depth. At the surface the pressure is the same in both. At what depth in liquid A is the pressure equal to the pressure in liquid B at a depth of $4.0\,\text{m}$?

Inside a pressure cooker there is a gauge pressure of 0.85 bar (1 bar = 100 kPa). The area of the lid is 380 cm². How large a force does the gauge pressure exert on the lid? Give the answer in kilonewtons.

level3.text: A hiker's mass with a rucksack is $85\,\text{kg}$. Soft snow supports the hiker if the pressure on it is at most 6.0 kPa. When walking, the hiker is for a moment on only one foot. How large must the area of one snowshoe be at least, so that the hiker does not sink?

The rainwater barrel at a cottage is full of water, and its tight lid is against the water. The area of the lid is 0.25 m². A thin vertical hose is installed through the lid and filled with water to a height of $4.0\,\text{m}$ above the lid. The hose holds only $0.40\,\textsf{l}$ of water. By how much does the force with which the water in the barrel presses on the lid increase? Give the answer in kilonewtons.

At the bottom of an oil separator well at a petrol station there is a $1.60\,\text{m}$ layer of water and on top of it a $0.40\,\text{m}$ layer of oil with a density of $850\,\text{kg/m}^3$. How large is the gauge pressure at the bottom of the well? The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg/m}^3$. Give the answer in kilopascals.
